change.title: pr-5
change.description: adding flexbox to header via mixins (all prefixes)
change.author: awesomerobot

findings.title: Making .small-action a flex row breaks the layout of the description box and the mobile overrides
findings.body:
`.small-action` is now `display:flex` (l.264), but `.small-action-desc` (l.279) gets no `flex: 1`/width, so it is sized to its content instead of filling the row. Two effects follow, from reading `small-action.hbs` and the existing rules.

1. The delete/edit `<button>`s sit inside `.small-action-desc` with `float:right` (l.306-310). They used to land at the right edge of the full-width row. Now they float to the right edge of a shrink-wrapped box, so for a short description they sit right next to the text. Adding `flex: 1` to `.small-action-desc` keeps the old behaviour.
2. `app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:516-532` was written for the old layout and is not updated. `.custom-message { margin-left: -40px }` compensated for the removed `padding-left: 4em`. Padding is now `0 1.5%`, so the message is pulled 40px left of the desc box and overlaps the `.topic-avatar` icon. `.small-action.time-gap .topic-avatar { margin-top:-5px }` now offsets an element that `align-items:center` already centers. `.small-action-desc p { padding-top:0 }` is now a no-op.

Check the small-action and time-gap rows on mobile and desktop with the buttons and a custom message. Update or remove the mobile overrides in the same PR.

findings.title: Mixin issues: non-existent property, and the old-syntax fallbacks only work for some values
findings.body:
`-ms-align-items` (l.121) is not a property in any IE/Edge version (IE10 uses `-ms-flex-align`, l.120), so it is dead output. Line 120 also has trailing whitespace, and the block is indented 4 spaces while the other mixins use 2.

The 2009-syntax fallbacks also only accept a subset of values. `-webkit-box-align` takes `start|end|center|baseline|stretch`, not `flex-start`/`flex-end`. `-webkit-box-ordinal-group` is 1-based, so `order(0)` or a negative value is invalid there. The current callers (`center`, `baseline`, 2, 3) are fine. If the mixins are meant to be reused, either map the values or note the limitation in a comment. Check whether the asset pipeline already runs autoprefixer. If it does, the hand-written prefixes are redundant.

contracts.action: Header .contents becomes a flex container; logo, panel, extra-info become flex items
contracts.equivalent_path: Previous layout: .title floated left, .panel floated right, .extra-info-wrapper in normal flow with overflow:hidden (BFC)
contracts.before_after: Before: floats plus a BFC for extra info. After: .contents is flex with align-items:center, panel has margin-left:auto and order 3, and extra-info-wrapper has order 2 (topic.scss:30). DOM order in header.hbs is home-logo, panel, extra-info, so the visual order is logo, extra-info, panel. Desktop .extra-info-wrapper keeps overflow:hidden and so can shrink. The .title float rule is removed. I found no other `.title` descendant of .d-header in the templates I searched.
contracts.visible_effect: Header items vertically centered and the panel pushed right; the topic title appears between the logo and the panel.
contracts.failure_mode: The `.clearfix` pseudo-elements on .contents become zero-size flex items, which is harmless. I did not verify rendering with long topic titles.

contracts.equivalent_path: Old float-based layout with padding-left:4em on .small-action-desc
contracts.before_after: Before: desc is a block that fills the row, with right-floated buttons at the row's right edge. After: desc is a content-sized flex item. Mobile overrides still assume the old padding.
contracts.visible_effect: Buttons are misplaced and the custom message overlaps the icon on mobile (see the finding).

summary: The header flexbox conversion looks consistent with the header template. The small-action flex conversion likely regresses the desktop and mobile layout: `.small-action-desc` is not stretched, so the right-floated buttons sit next to the text, and the mobile `-40px` custom-message margin was never updated for the new padding. The new mixins also contain a non-existent `-ms-align-items` property and some formatting nits. I read all five files and checked the templates and the mobile and desktop overrides they interact with. I did not render anything.
